import pytest
from store.cart import Cart, Item


def test_issue_remove_whole_line_without_qty():
    """With no qty, remove the whole line (current behavior)."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1500, qty=3))
    cart.remove("MUG")
    assert len(cart.items) == 0  # 1 - 1 = 0 lines


def test_issue_remove_partial_decreases_qty():
    """With a qty, decrease the line by that many units."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1500, qty=3))
    cart.remove("MUG", qty=1)
    assert cart.items[0].qty == 2  # 3 - 1 = 2


def test_issue_remove_exact_qty_removes_line():
    """Removing the line when it reaches zero."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1500, qty=3))
    cart.remove("MUG", qty=3)
    assert len(cart.items) == 0  # 3 - 3 = 0, line removed


def test_issue_remove_more_than_available_raises():
    """Removing more units than are in the cart raises KeyError."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1500, qty=2))
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        cart.remove("MUG", qty=3)  # 3 > 2 in cart


def test_issue_remove_unknown_sku_raises():
    """A SKU that is not in the cart raises KeyError."""
    cart = Cart()
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        cart.remove("MUG")  # 0 lines in empty cart


def test_issue_remove_unknown_sku_with_qty_raises():
    """A SKU that is not in the cart raises KeyError even with qty."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="CUP", name="Cup", price_cents=1000, qty=1))
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        cart.remove("MUG", qty=1)  # only CUP in cart, MUG missing


def test_issue_remove_partial_changes_shipping():
    """Partial remove dropping discounted subtotal below $50 restores $5.99 shipping."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=2000, qty=3))
    cart.remove("MUG", qty=1)
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 599  # 2000*2=4000 < 5000 so 599


def test_contract_subtotal_sums_lines():
    """Subtotal is the sum of price_cents * qty over every line in the cart."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1500, qty=2))
    cart.add(Item(sku="BOOK", name="Book", price_cents=2000, qty=1))
    assert cart.subtotal_cents() == 5000  # 1500*2 + 2000*1 = 3000 + 2000 = 5000


def test_contract_add_same_sku_increases_qty():
    """Adding a SKU that is already in the cart increases that line's qty."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1500, qty=1))
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1500, qty=1))
    assert cart.items[0].qty == 2  # 1 + 1 = 2


def test_contract_percent_coupon_rounded_down():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal, rounded down to the cent."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=1999, qty=1))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 199  # 1999*10//100 = 19990//100 = 199 (199.9 floored)


def test_contract_empty_cart_no_shipping():
    """An empty cart has no shipping charge."""
    cart = Cart()
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 0  # empty cart = 0, not 599


def test_contract_total_sums_discounted_shipping_tax():
    """total = discounted subtotal + shipping + tax, and is never negative."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="MUG", name="Mug", price_cents=3000, qty=2))
    assert cart.total_cents() == 6480  # 6000 + 0 + 480 = 6480 (6000*8//100=480, 6000>=5000 so ship 0)
